title: Piece meta
description: Stage 9 output (meta.json), one per night, for published, b-side and shelved nights alike. Embeds every stage artefact for the gallery and the audit trail. A night shelved early (research, brief or build never produced output) has null dossier, mood, brief, best_attempt, liner_note, screenshots and piece_rel_path as appropriate. Published and b-side nights must have all of them.

reason.description: Why the night is a b-side or shelved, shown on the 'no release tonight' card. Required non-null for b-side and shelved, null for published.

publish_threshold.description: Publish threshold in force tonight (72 to 85 under the ratchet rule).

best_attempt.description: Attempt number whose piece was kept. Null only when shelved before any attempt rendered.

attempts.description: Every build attempt in order, with its gate result and jury verdict.

model.description: Model used for the build, for example 'haiku' or 'opus'.

effort.description: Effort flag ('low' for Opus), null when not set.

gates.description: Null only when the build produced no piece to gate (outcome build_failed).

verdict.description: Null when the jury did not run (gates failed or build failed).

liner_note.description: Published liner note (from the brief, possibly edited).

screenshots.description: Screenshots of the best attempt, relative to the piece folder. Null when shelved before render.

piece_rel_path.description: Piece path relative to site/, for example 'pieces/2026-11-22/index.html'. Null when shelved.

status.description: published: score >= threshold and pairwise pass. b-side: best score 60 to threshold-1. shelved: below 60 or no renderable piece.
